As you may already know, hair loss is a common condition that men and women face every day. According to this study, 56 million people suffer from hair loss in the United States alone. With this statistic in mind, there is no doubt that you are on the hunt for the best hair growth treatment available on the market to help combat their condition.

In this article we are going to discuss low level light therapy and laser caps. These FDA-cleared medical devices are clinically proven to help regrow and strengthen the hair on the scalps of men and women. Read on to learn more about these devices, and the different companies and models on the market available to you today!

About Laser Caps

As previously mentioned, laser caps are an FDA-cleared medical device that are designed to help regrow hair on the scalp. These devices use low level light therapy (LLLT) to stimulate blood flow in the scalp tissue and improve hair health and growth.

Read more: LLLT for Hair Growth

Laser caps are a hands-free, completely portable device, designed for convenience. This means that you can complete your treatment therapy whenever is convenient for you and at a location that you prefer. This alleviates trips to a clinic to have this treatment performed and allows you to complete it in the comfort of your own home.

Read more: Do Laser Caps Work for Hair Loss?

Now that you have some background on what laser caps are, let’s dive deep into the different brands on the market today. First, we are going to discuss Kiierr laser caps. Then we will compare other laser cap companies to Kiierr so you can be familiar with the similarities and differences between each.

Kiierr Laser Caps

Kiierr’s laser caps are a lightweight, portable, non-invasive, pain-free and convenient hair growth option for both men and women suffering from hair loss. The caps are equipped with either 148 or 272 medical grade laser diodes. As you can imagine, more laser diodes allow for faster hair growth.

Kiierr’s caps offer complete scalp coverage and use medical grade laser diodes to emit the low level light therapy to the scalp tissue. The wavelength of the light therapy in the caps is 650 nm, which is proven to be an efficient wavelength of light to encourage new hair growth.

Read more: Kiierr Laser Science

The laser caps are worn every other day for 30-minutes. They include a built-in timer feature that automatically shut the caps off after the 30-minute treatment is over, which alleviates you from having to time the treatment yourself.

You can also expect a free 2-year warranty with the purchase of your cap along with a 7-month money back guarantee if you do not see results after using the cap for a solid 7-months. This allows you to make their purchases confidently.

Depending on the individual, results are typically reported around the 4-7-month mark of religiously using the caps and completing the treatments every other day for the 30-minute time period.

Read more: A Complete Guide to Kiierr’s Laser Cap

Now that you know the specifics and details about the Kiierr laser cap, let’s discuss some other companies on the market and how they compare to Kiierr. See below to learn more! 

Kiierr vs Rogaine

Both Kiierr and Rogaine are beneficial hair regrowth treatments. They are easy to use and are affordable options for people looking to regrow their hair. Both options are also non-invasive. However, when it comes to producing long-term effects, we suggest Kiierr as the best option.

However, the good thing to note, is that you can use Rogaine in conjunction with laser caps and laser therapy. This can help provide maximized results depending on the individual.

Kiierr laser caps are a more effective hair regrowth treatment that provides full head coverage and natural growth. The laser treatment uses the advanced technology of low-level laser lights and is gaining approval from medical professionals all over the world.

Read more: Rogaine Reviews vs Kiierr

Kiierr Laser Cap vs Laser Comb

Kiierr vs laser comb reviews are quite different depending on which laser comb you purchase. However, both are FDA-cleared devices and can contain medical grade laser diodes that emit the low level light therapy treatment.

These two companies differ largely in price and how the treatment is completed. Laser caps are an intended treatment therapy that require no effort once you place the cap on your head. You simply turn them on and then back off once treatment is completed. On the other hand, laser combs require more effort. You must physically comb through your hair with the device in order to hit all areas of the scalp and hair that you want to be stimulated by the low level light therapy.

Also keep in mind that laser caps provide full scalp coverage. It is easy to miss some spots during treatment with the laser comb if you are not consistent. Overall, the laser cap for hair loss is more convenient to use.

Read more: Kiierr Laser Cap vs Laser Comb Reviews

Kiierr vs HairMax

Kiierr and Hairmax are similar in the fact that they both use medical grade laser diodes in their products. Neither use LEDs, which you may know are less effective than medical grade laser diodes. Both companies also offer a free 2-year warranty and free shipping within the United States.

The main differences between the two companies is the money back guarantee policy and the design of the products. Kiierr offers a 7-month growth guarantee and Hairmax offers 6. Kiierr’s laser caps also contain more laser diodes, which means you can see hair growth faster in a shorter amount of time.

If you are strictly looking to compare laser caps, Hairmax does offer one. It contains the same amount of laser diodes as Kiierr (272) but the price range is much more. The Kiierr272Premier laser cap can be purchased for $845, where the Hairmax Laser 272 PowerFlex Cap is sold for $1,899.

Read more: Kiierr vs HairMax Reviews

Kiierr vs Grivamax

Kiierr and Grivamax are identical in laser diodes which is beneficial for both products. LED lights aren’t as preferred, and many hair growth caps use these in their product to make a cheaper cap.

A big difference between the two hair growth caps will be found in their guarantees and warranty. Kiierr offers a 7 month guarantee or your money back. Grivamax gives a 6-month guarantee.

Kiierr gives a two-year warranty with each cap, allowing you to be confident and protected with your purchase. Grivamax on the other hand has a one-year warranty.

Read more: Kiierr vs Grivamax Laser Cap Review

Kiierr vs Revian Red 

Both Kiierr and Revian offer free shipping on all purchases.

Kiierr contains strictly medical grade laser diodes while Revian contains only LEDs in their caps.

A big difference between the two hair growth caps will be found in their guarantees. Kiierr offers a 7 month guarantee or your money back. Revian gives a 6 month guarantee.

Read more: Kiierr vs Revian Red Hair Growth System Review

Kiierr vs Theradome

Kiierr and Theradome are similar in the fact that they both use laser diodes in their FDA-cleared medical devices.

A big difference between the two hair growth caps will be found in their guarantees, warranty, and laser diode count. Kiierr offers a 7 month guarantee or your money back. Theradome offers a 180-day money back guarantee.

Kiierr gives a two-year warranty with each cap, allowing you to be confident and protected with your purchase. Theradome only offers a one-year limited warranty on their products.

As far as laser diodes, Kiierr laser hair growth caps contain 272. Theradome on the other hand only makes a helmet that contains 80 laser diodes. Keep in mind that the more laser diodes a device contains, the more effective they are in regrowing hair thicker and fuller.

Read more: Kiierr vs Theradome Laser Helmet Review

Kiierr vs Keranique

Both Kiierr and Keranique are both happy to offer a money back guarantee on their products and pride themselves in taking care of their customers. Products from both companies are clinically proven and a non-invasive option to regrow hair on the scalp.

However, Kiierr is more of a technology-based company, offering the FDA-cleared laser cap and their number one powerhouse hair growth option. Keranique mainly sells supplements that are intended to help with scalp health and hair growth.

Another major difference between Kiierr vs Keranique hair products is that Kiierr is intended for both men and women suffering from hair loss while Keranique is made for women only.

Read more: Kiierr vs Keranique Reviews

Kiierr vs Roman Hair Growth Products

Roman offers free 2-day shipping on all products, as does Kiierr. Also, both companies offer hair growth products for individuals looking to regrow their hair.

Roman’s hair loss products are intended for male use only. Kiierr’s products are designed for both men and women suffering from hair loss.

Kiierr offers a 7-month money back guarantee, where if you do not see results, you can return the products for your full money back. Kiierr is also a hair growth company that uses high-end technology to naturally and effectively fight back against hair loss. Roman uses only topical and oral supplement products.

Read more: Roman Hair Loss Products vs Kiierr

Kiierr vs Bosley

Bosley’s and Kiierr’s products aim to address your hair loss problems. However, Kiierr made it so convenient for just about anyone to enjoy the maximum benefits of the LLLT technology.

The main difference is between the price of the laser cap devices that both Kiierr and Bosley sell to their customers. Bosley products are significantly more expensive than Kiierr’s, especially for laser caps that contain the same number of laser diodes. For instance, Kiierr’s 272Premier laser cap costs $845 where the Bosley Revitalizer 272 costs $2,079.

Read more: Kiierr vs Bosley Hair Products

Kiierr vs Illumiflow

Kiierr and illumiflow are similar in laser diodes which is beneficial for both products.

A big difference between the two hair growth caps will be found in their guarantees and warranty. Kiierr offers a 7 month guarantee or your money back. Illumiflow gives a 6 month guarantee.

The warranties also differ between the two products. Kiierr gives a two-year warranty with each cap, allowing you to be confident and protected with your purchase.

Illumiflow on the other hand has a five year warranty, and if any issues arise, send you a new one for the cost of shipping.

Read more: Kiierr vs Illumiflow Reviews

Kiierr vs Irestore

Kiierr’s hair growth caps are seen as a far more superior system, because not only does it use 148 lasers in one cap and 272 lasers in the other, but pricing is similar, starting out at $695 and ending at $1,295. This of course depends on what system you choose to get. As you can imagine, results will be effective much quicker when using the 272 laser diode cap versus the 148 laser diode cap. Kiierr uses only premium medical grade laser diodes in their caps, using not one LED light throughout their entire cap.

Kiierr also has a seven-month money back growth guarantee. This money back guarantee states that the customer is eligible for their full money back if they do not see new hair regrowth in the problematic areas. The customer must use the cap for a minimum of 7-months. You will also receive a two-year product warranty, where if any issues arise, we will send a new unit absolutely free.

iRestore has two laser caps on the market as of today. One cap consists of 51 lasers and LEDs while the other consists of 282 lasers and LEDs. Their Essential cap uses 51 medical-grade lasers and LEDs inside their helmet, consisting of 21 medical-grade lasers, and 30 medical-grade LEDs. We are unaware of how the medical grade lasers and LEDs are split within this new cap.

iRestore offers a 12-month money back guarantee on their products and a product warranty. Their free shipping is also a nice perk if you order their products.

Read more: Kiierr vs iRestore

Kiierr vs Hims

Both of these companies offer hair loss products for individuals suffering from overall hair loss. Hims offers products that are FDA-approved, and Kiierr’s laser caps are FDA-cleared. This helps customers feel at ease when purchasing, as they know that the products are safe and effective to use.

Both companies offer a money back guarantee if success is not seen by religiously using the products as directed. Hims money back guarantee is 90-days, where Kiierr’s is 7-months. Both companies also offer free shipping on all orders.

Although these companies are similar in some ways, there are also big differences between them. Kiierr offers products for both men and women suffering from hair loss, where hims is targeting men only.

Read more: Hims Hair Products vs Kiierr

Kiierr vs iGrow

When comparing Kiierr laser cap and the iGrow laser helmet, there are a few things to keep in mind. Two things to be aware of are pricing and number of lasers/LEDs. Although iGrow is cheaper than Kiierr, it also only has a total of 51 medical-grade lasers, consisting of 21 lasers and 30 LEDs.

However, Kiierr has a total of 148 or 272 medical grade lasers depending on which unit you choose. Kiierr uses only premium laser diodes, using not one LED light throughout their entire cap, making it far more superior than its counterpart, getting the job done efficiently and effectively.

Read more: Kiierr vs iGrow Helmet

Conclusion: Best Hair Regrowth Treatment

Laser caps have proven to be one of the best hair growth treatment options available to men and women. Their convenience, portability, and hands-free characteristics make them a favorable option to regrow your hair.

As they are gaining the recognition and approval from medical professionals and scientists all around the world, you can feel confident that they can help you combat your hair loss condition. Get ahead of your hair loss and start your hair growth journey with laser caps today!
